answer.answer:
### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” S-parameter capability list for Aerospace / Defense; the directly supported priority area is satellite payload / component RF testing, where R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level testing of converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements [44].
### Recommended first
Prioritize a high-performance VNA capability set around wide frequency coverage, high dynamic range / sensitivity, group delay and phase, frequency-converting DUT support, noise figure / gain, pulsed and nonlinear measurements, deembedding / fixture correction, uncertainty analysis, and multiport / phase-coherent architectures [14][41][44][49][75].
### Product and option mapping table
| Product line | S-parameter / VNA capability to prioritize | Confirmed option / specification | Why it matters for Aerospace / Defense-related use | Evidence | Gap / quote risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNA | Component-level RF measurements for converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase | R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level testing in satellite payload / component testing [44] | This is the clearest passage-supported fit to aerospace satellite payload / component work [44] | [44] | The passages do not rank these as “most important” [44] |
| R&S ZNA | Wide frequency coverage | ZNA26: 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz; ZNA43: 10 MHz to 43.5 GHz; ZNA50: 10 MHz to 50 GHz; ZNA67: 10 MHz to 67 GHz [75] | Satellite payload / component RF testing cites R&S ZNA key features up to 67 GHz [49] | [49][75] | Knowledge base does not state which A/D program or band requires each model [49][75] |
| R&S ZNA | High dynamic range and sensitivity | Dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction; sensitivity >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options and –162 dBm measured with options normalized to 1 Hz [41] | These are core VNA performance capabilities for low-level transmission / reflection characterization, while the satellite source identifies ZNA for component RF measurements [41][49] | [41][49] | The passages do not tie a specific dynamic-range number to a specific satellite test limit [41][49] |
| R&S ZNA | Group delay and phase on converters / mixers | R&S ZNA is used for converter / mixer group delay and phase measurements in satellite payload / component testing [49]; R&S ZNA-K9 is group delay measurements [14] | Group delay measurements characterize satellite communications transmission-path phase distortions and channel band-edge distortion [65] | [14][49][65] | Actual performance depends on DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, SNR, option and calibration setup [64] |
| R&S ZNA | Frequency-converting DUT / mixer support | R&S ZNA-K4 scalar mixer measurements, R&S ZNA-K5 vector mixer measurements, and R&S ZNA-K9 group delay measurements are listed software / measurement options [14] | Satellite payload/component testing identifies converters and mixers as ZNA use cases [44][49] | [14][44][49] | The passages do not provide a full uncertainty budget or test-case limits [64] |
| R&S ZNA | Multi-source / multi-receiver, phase-coherent architecture | 4-port instruments support up to 4 independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources, a 5th source for LO supply, and 8 true receivers without multiplexing; 2-port instruments support up to 2 independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources, a 3rd source for LO supply, and 4 true receivers without multiplexing [75] | The satellite payload source lists ZNA key features including up to eight independent receivers, four phase-coherent sources, two internal LO sources and an internal combiner [49] | [49][75] | The passages do not map these architecture features to a named defense radar or EW use case [49][75] |
| R&S ZNA | Noise figure and gain measurement | R&S ZNA-K30 noise figure measurement is listed [14] | Satellite payload/component testing lists noise figure and gain measurements as a main RF test item, using R&S FS-SNS or R&S ZNA-K30 [43] | [14][43] | The passages do not provide a ZNA-K30 uncertainty value for a specific DUT [43] |
| R&S ZNA | Pulsed signal capability | R&S ZNA-K7 measurements on pulsed signals is listed [14] | Pulsed signal measurement is an available ZNA measurement option [14] | [14] | The passages do not directly connect pulsed ZNA measurements to Aerospace / Defense applications [14] |
| R&S ZNA | Deembedding and fixture correction | R&S ZNA-K210 EaZy deembedding, R&S ZNA-K220 in-situ deembedding, R&S ZNA-K230 smart fixture deembedding and R&S ZNA-K231 Delta-L PCB characterization are listed [14] | Deembedding corrects measurement setup cables and fixtures frequency response in satellite group delay measurement context [7] | [7][14] | The passages do not state that each ZNA deembedding option is used in satellite payload testing [7][14] |
| R&S ZNA | Time-domain and signal-integrity-related views | R&S ZNA-K2 time domain analysis, R&S ZNA-K20 extended time domain analysis, and R&S ZNA-K20 including eye diagram on ZNA67EXT software list are stated [14][23] | These are confirmed VNA capabilities relevant when time-domain behavior or eye diagram analysis is required [14][23] | [14][23] | The passages do not directly tie time-domain or eye-diagram options to Aerospace / Defense applications [14][23] |
| R&S ZNA67EXT | Extension to 110 GHz | R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm VNA system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz with 2- or 4-port variants [94] | This provides a confirmed VNA frequency-extension capability beyond the 67 GHz ZNA base range [75][94] | [75][94] | Knowledge base does not directly state R&S ZNA67EXT is recommended for Aerospace / Defense or satellite testing [94] |
| R&S ZNB3000 | Broad VNA measurement options | ZNB3000 options include time domain analysis, distance to fault, frequency conversion, intermodulation, gain compression, pulsed source measurements, noise figure, real-time uncertainty analysis, SNP assistant, deembedding and Delta-L PCB characterization [16] | These are confirmed VNA capabilities that overlap with common RF component characterization needs [16] | [16] | No passage directly recommends ZNB3000 for satellite payload / component testing [16] |
| R&S ZNL20 | Lower-frequency 2-port VNA capability | R&S ZNL20 is a 20 GHz 2-port VNA with 5 kHz to 20 GHz VNA frequency range, 50 Ω impedance, 1 Hz frequency resolution and 1 to 100001 measurement points per trace [59][60] | This is a confirmed VNA capability set for lower-frequency RF measurements [59][60] | [59][60] | No passage directly links ZNL20 to Aerospace / Defense applications [59][60] |
### Scenario cut-in suggestions
| Scenario | Recommended capability set | Cut-in point | Unverified item |
|---|---|---|---|
| Satellite payload / component RF validation | R&S ZNA for converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements [44] | Lead with component-level group delay / phase and converter / mixer characterization because satellite testing identifies these ZNA roles [44][49][65] | The passages do not provide a ranked list of S-parameter capabilities [44] |
| Satellite channel distortion / band-edge work | Group delay and phase measurement capability, including R&S ZNA-K9 group delay measurements [14][65] | Group delay is used to characterize satellite communications transmission-path phase distortions and band-edge distortion [65] | Accuracy and test limits depend on DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, SNR, option and calibration setup [64] |
| Frequency-converting payload components | Scalar mixer, vector mixer and converter group delay capability via R&S ZNA-K4, R&S ZNA-K5 and R&S ZNA-K9 [14] | Satellite payload/component testing lists converters and mixers as R&S ZNA component-level use cases [44][49] | The passages do not provide full uncertainty budget, test limits, standard chapter or test case ID [64] |
| Low-level / high-loss component characterization | High dynamic range and sensitivity, including >129 dB specified dynamic range without options and up to 170 dB maximum attainable range allowing full 2-port correction [41] | Use dynamic range and sensitivity as performance differentiators for RF component measurements [41][49] | The passages do not tie these numeric specs to a specific A/D acceptance criterion [41][49] |
| mmWave / very high frequency characterization | R&S ZNA up to 67 GHz or R&S ZNA67EXT 10 MHz to 110 GHz capability [75][94] | Use ZNA for confirmed satellite component testing up to 67 GHz, and treat ZNA67EXT as a confirmed 110 GHz VNA system capability [49][75][94] | The passages do not directly state ZNA67EXT is used for Aerospace / Defense or satellite applications [94] |
| Fixture-heavy or cabled measurements | Deembedding / fixture correction capability, including R&S ZNA-K210, K220, K230 and K231 options [14] | Deembedding can correct cables and fixtures frequency response in the measurement setup [7] | The passages do not state each listed ZNA deembedding option is used in satellite payload testing [7][14] |
### Limitations
The direct Aerospace / Defense RAW passage only identifies an “Aerospace & Defense Test” business-development context and does not state S-parameter capabilities [98].
The strongest application-specific evidence in the passages is for satellite payload and component testing, not for all Aerospace / Defense domains [43][44][49].

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的適用性與優點
- 適合 unstable LOs 的 frequency converting DUTs，因 DUT internal LO 的 frequency 與 phase deviations 可落在 IF bandwidth 範圍內，最高到 several MHz。
- New internal combiner 可簡化 measurement setup，兩個 signals 不再需要 external connection。
- Two-port [[R&S ZNA]] 搭配 optional second source，可量測 embedded LO converter group delay 與 intermodulation。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 的 two independent LOs for internal receivers 可讓 mixers 的 RF/IF 同時量測。
- Measurement speeds 為 single LO 的兩倍，並降低 conversion loss 與 group delay measurements 的 trace noise。
- 除 group delay 外，也可透過 integrating group delay 計算 relative phase 與 deviation from linear phase。

- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” S-parameter capability list for Aerospace / Defense; the directly supported priority area is satellite payload / component RF testing, where R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level testing of converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements [44].
### Recommended first
Prioritize a high-performance VNA capability set around wide frequency coverage, high dynamic range / sensitivity, group delay and phase, frequency-converting DUT support, noise figure / gain, pulsed and nonlinear measurements, deembedding / fixture correction, uncertainty analysis, and multiport / phase-coherent architectures [14][41][44][49][75].
### Product and option mapping table
| Product line | S-parameter / VNA capability to prioritize | Confirmed option / specification | Why it matters for Aerospace / Defense-related use | Evidence | Gap / quote risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNA | Component-level RF measurements for converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase | R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level testing in satellite payload / component testing [44] | This is the clearest passage-supported fit to aerospace satellite payload / component work [44] | [44] | The passages do not rank these as “most important” [44] |
| R&S ZNA | Wide frequency coverage | ZNA26: 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz; ZNA43: 10 MHz to 43.5 GHz; ZNA50: 10 MHz to 50 GHz; ZNA67: 10 MHz to 67 GHz [75] | Satellite payload / component RF testing cites R&S ZNA key features up to 67 GHz [49] | [49][75] | Knowledge base does not state which A/D program or band requires each model [49][75] |
| R&S ZNA | High dynamic range and sensitivity | Dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction; sensitivity >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options and –162 dBm measured with options normalized to 1 Hz [41] | These are core VNA performance capabilities for low-level transmission / reflection characterization, while the satellite source identifies ZNA for component RF measurements [41][49] | [41][49] | The passages do not tie a specific dynamic-range number to a specific satellite test limit [41][49] |
| R&S ZNA | Group delay and phase on converters / mixers | R&S ZNA is used for converter / mixer group delay and phase measurements in satellite payload / component testing [49]; R&S ZNA-K9 is group delay measurements [14] | Group delay measurements characterize satellite communications transmission-path phase distortions and channel band-edge distortion [65] | [14][49][65] | Actual performance depends on DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, SNR, option and calibration setup [64] |
| R&S ZNA | Frequency-converting DUT / mixer support | R&S ZNA-K4 scalar mixer measurements, R&S ZNA-K5 vector mixer measurements, and R&S ZNA-K9 group delay measurements are listed software / measurement options [14] | Satellite payload/component testing identifies converters and mixers as ZNA use cases [44][49] | [14][44][49] | The passages do not provide a full uncertainty budget or test-case limits [64] |
| R&S ZNA | Multi-source / multi-receiver, phase-coherent architecture | 4-port instruments support up to 4 independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources, a 5th source for LO supply, and 8 true receivers without multiplexing; 2-port instruments support up to 2 independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources, a 3rd source for LO supply, and 4 true receivers without multiplexing [75] | The satellite payload source lists ZNA key features including up to eight independent receivers, four phase-coherent sources, two internal LO sources and an internal combiner [49] | [49][75] | The passages do not map these architecture features to a named defense radar or EW use case [49][75] |
| R&S ZNA | Noise figure and gain measurement | R&S ZNA-K30 noise figure measurement is listed [14] | Satellite payload/component testing lists noise figure and gain measurements as a main RF test item, using R&S FS-SNS or R&S ZNA-K30 [43] | [14][43] | The passages do not provide a ZNA-K30 uncertainty value for a specific DUT [43] |
| R&S ZNA | Pulsed signal capability | R&S ZNA-K7 measurements on pulsed signals is listed [14] | Pulsed signal measurement is an available ZNA measurement option [14] | [14] | The passages do not directly connect pulsed ZNA measurements to Aerospace / Defense applications [14] |

| Satellite payload / component RF validation | R&S ZNA for converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements [44] | Lead with component-level group delay / phase and converter / mixer characterization because satellite testing identifies these ZNA roles [44][49][65] | The passages do not provide a ranked list of S-parameter capabilities [44] |
| Satellite channel distortion / band-edge work | Group delay and phase measurement capability, including R&S ZNA-K9 group delay measurements [14][65] | Group delay is used to characterize satellite communications transmission-path phase distortions and band-edge distortion [65] | Accuracy and test limits depend on DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, SNR, option and calibration setup [64] |
| Frequency-converting payload components | Scalar mixer, vector mixer and converter group delay capability via R&S ZNA-K4, R&S ZNA-K5 and R&S ZNA-K9 [14] | Satellite payload/component testing lists converters and mixers as R&S ZNA component-level use cases [44][49] | The passages do not provide full uncertainty budget, test limits, standard chapter or test case ID [64] |
| Low-level / high-loss component characterization | High dynamic range and sensitivity, including >129 dB specified dynamic range without options and up to 170 dB maximum attainable range allowing full 2-port correction [41] | Use dynamic range and sensitivity as performance differentiators for RF component measurements [41][49] | The passages do not tie these numeric specs to a specific A/D acceptance criterion [41][49] |
| mmWave / very high frequency characterization | R&S ZNA up to 67 GHz or R&S ZNA67EXT 10 MHz to 110 GHz capability [75][94] | Use ZNA for confirmed satellite component testing up to 67 GHz, and treat ZNA67EXT as a confirmed 110 GHz VNA system capability [49][75][94] | The passages do not directly state ZNA67EXT is used for Aerospace / Defense or satellite applications [94] |

### Limitations
The direct Aerospace / Defense RAW passage only identifies an “Aerospace & Defense Test” business-development context and does not state S-parameter capabilities [98].
The strongest application-specific evidence in the passages is for satellite payload and component testing, not for all Aerospace / Defense domains [43][44][49].

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色

- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

- [[Group delay]] measurements 用於表徵 satellite communications transmission path 的 phase distortions。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的適用性與優點
- 適合 unstable LOs 的 frequency converting DUTs，因 DUT internal LO 的 frequency 與 phase deviations 可落在 IF bandwidth 範圍內，最高到 several MHz。
- New internal combiner 可簡化 measurement setup，兩個 signals 不再需要 external connection。
- Two-port [[R&S ZNA]] 搭配 optional second source，可量測 embedded LO converter group delay 與 intermodulation。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 的 two independent LOs for internal receivers 可讓 mixers 的 RF/IF 同時量測。
- Measurement speeds 為 single LO 的兩倍，並降低 conversion loss 與 group delay measurements 的 trace noise。
- 除 group delay 外，也可透過 integrating group delay 計算 relative phase 與 deviation from linear phase。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” S-parameter capability list for Aerospace / Defense; the directly supported priority area is satellite payload / component RF testing, where R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level testing of converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements [44].
### Recommended first
Prioritize a high-performance VNA capability set around wide frequency coverage, high dynamic range / sensitivity, group delay and phase, frequency-converting DUT support, noise figure / gain, pulsed and nonlinear measurements, deembedding / fixture correction, uncertainty analysis, and multiport / phase-coherent architectures [14][41][44][49][75].

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。

- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 為什麼量測 group delay
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- [[Group delay]] measurements 用於表徵 satellite communications transmission path 的 phase distortions。
- Bandpass filter 會在 band edges 增加更多 group delay。
- 在 satellite communications systems 中，frequency converter 或 transponder channels 的 relative group delay 對判定 each channel band edges 的 distortion amount 很關鍵。
